visualCharacteristics.purpose: Large clickable category tiles with the title overlaid on the photo
visualCharacteristics.description: Stacked full-bleed 552px image tiles; whole tile is a link with an uppercase white title and chevron overlaid bottom-left, hover zoom

contentPattern.structure: image cell, then a cell with a heading or paragraph containing the title link
contentPattern.rationale: Repeating look-alike items each linking to a page; same structure repeated, so Cards (image + title link) rather than two separate heroes.

usage: Stacked full-width image tiles, each fully clickable, with the title and a chevron overlaid bottom-left. One row per tile: image cell, and a cell with a heading or paragraph containing the link.
reuseGuidance: Use for large category entry points (e.g. Kitchens & Baths). For small grids use cards-swatch.

blockContent.description: Two look-alike full-width image tiles (Kitchens & Baths, Unique Installs) with overlaid title linking to a category page

rows: Text: optional heading, description, CTA link
structure.notes: One row per card. Section 2: image + linked design name paragraph. Section 4: image + H3 linked title. Section 6: image + H3 + paragraph + link.
